sentences.text: Perusahaan Intan memproduksi makanan ringan yang dijual di bandara.
sentences.en: Intan's company produces snacks that are sold at the airport.
sentences.ko: 인탄의 회사는 공항에서 파는 과자를 생산해요.

sentences.text: Ibu Bayu dulu bekerja sebagai pembantu, dan majikannya sangat baik.
sentences.en: Bayu's mother used to work as a housemaid, and her employer was very kind.
sentences.ko: 바유의 어머니는 예전에 가사도우미로 일했는데 고용주가 아주 친절했어요.

sentences.text: Di ruang kedatangan, seorang pekerja rumah tangga dijemput oleh majikan barunya.
sentences.en: In the arrivals hall, a domestic worker was picked up by her new employer.
sentences.ko: 도착 홀에서 한 가사도우미가 새 고용주의 마중을 받았어요.
